Name: Peach's Panda Furniture
Author: peachsmile
Description:
请注意：本模组中的所有家具均为人工智能绘制生成。如果您介意这一点，请忽略此模组。
Please note: All furniture in this mod is generated by artificial intelligence. If this is a concern for you, please disregard this mod.

本模组目前共包含 55件 装饰家具。
This mod currently contains a total of 55 decorative furniture items.
[list]
[*]🐼 熊猫系列 (33件)：形态各异的可爱熊猫装饰。
[*]🐼 Panda Set (33 items): Adorable panda decorations in various poses.
[*]🦌 梅花鹿系列 (12件)：新增！温顺优雅的梅花鹿装饰。
[*]🦌 Sika Deer Set (12 items): NEW! Gentle and elegant sika deer decorations.
[*]💧 水生植物系列 (7件)：包括4株睡莲和3株小荷花。
[*]💧 Aquatic Plants Set (7 items): Includes 4 water lilies and 3 small lotuses.
[*]🪨 自然装饰 (2件)：石头与芦苇。
[*]🪨 Natural Decor (2 items): A stone and reeds.
[*]💡 芒草灯笼 (1件)：可放置在室外的温馨光源。
[*]💡 Miscanthus Lantern (1 item): A warm light source that can be placed outdoors.
[/list]更新说明 | Update Note最新版本中，芒草灯笼 现在可以放置在室外了。
In the latest version, the Miscanthus Lantern can now be placed outdoors.
获取方式 | How to Obtain所有家具均通过游戏内的 家具目录 获取。
All furniture can be obtained through the in-game Furniture Catalogue.
安装要求 | Requirements[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
这个模组新增了12个可爱的梅花鹿装饰家具。
This mod adds 12 adorable sika deer decorative furniture items.
同时，芒草灯笼现在可以放置在室外了。
Additionally, the Miscanthus Lantern can now be placed outdoors.
